Weapons.Name: Fire Bat
Weapons.Description: A close-range bat that applies Burn on each successful hit.

Weapons.Name: Ice Whip
Weapons.Description: A 1-2 range magic weapon. Deals bonus damage equal to Strength.

Weapons.Name: Mace
Weapons.Description: A sturdy 1-range mace. Deals bonus damage equal to Defense.

Weapons.Name: Toxic Sword
Weapons.Description: Applies Toxic on each successful weapon hit.

Weapons.Name: Stun Sword
Weapons.Description: Applies Stun on each successful weapon hit.

Weapons.Name: Weakening Sword
Weapons.Description: Applies Weakening on each successful weapon hit.

Weapons.Name: Fire Staff
Weapons.Description: A staff that shoots out fire.

Weapons.Name: Iron Claymore
Weapons.Description: A heavy physical weapon. Lowers Speed by 2.

Weapons.Name: Knife
Weapons.Description: A light melee weapon that strikes twice.

Weapons.Name: Time Sword
Weapons.Description: A low-might, high-accuracy sword that grants Spd +3.

Weapons.Name: Dark Tome
Weapons.Description: A dark-magic tome with fixed 2-tile range.

Weapons.Name: Thunder Lance
Weapons.Description: A close-range lance with a high critical-hit rate.

Weapons.Name: Magic Sword
Weapons.Description: A magical blade that attacks with magic.

Weapons.Name: Iron Bow
Weapons.Description: A bow that fires attacks at range.

Weapons.Name: Super Bow
Weapons.Description: A bow that fires twice at range.

Accessories.Name: Shield
Accessories.Description: Def +3. A sturdy shield that increases defense.

Consumables.Name: Invuln. Potion
Consumables.Description: Grants invulnerability, reducing all damage taken to 1 for one turn.

Skills.Name: Ignite Ground
Skills.Description: Set a targeted area ablaze for 2 rounds. Units standing in the flames receive Burn.

Skills.Name: Cleanse
Skills.Description: Remove all removable debuffs from an adjacent ally.

Skills.Name: Accelerate
Skills.Description: Refresh an adjacent ally so they can move and act again.

Skills.Name: Slow
Skills.Description: Inflict Movement -4 and Speed -4 on an enemy for one turn.

Skills.Name: Mass Accelerate
Skills.Description: Ultimate: Refresh all adjacent allies so they can move and act again. Excludes the caster.

Skills.Name: Thunderbolt
Skills.Description: Strike an enemy at range with magic damage and a high critical-hit rate.

Skills.Name: Storm Surge
Skills.Description: Gain Might +10 for the next combat.

Skills.Name: Atrocity
Skills.Description: Ultimate: A devastating lance strike that ignores Defense.

Skills.Name: Wrath Strike
Skills.Description: A forceful physical strike with extra power and accuracy.

Skills.Name: Astra
Skills.Description: A flurry of five rapid strikes.

Skills.Name: Snipe Shot
Skills.Description: Max Range +1. A careful ranged shot with extra reach and accuracy.

Skills.Name: Tempest Lance
Skills.Description: A lance combat art that strikes with overwhelming force.

Skills.Name: Smash
Skills.Description: A blunt combat art with high hit and a crushing swing.

Skills.Name: Luna
Skills.Description: A precise combat art that pierces through enemy defense or magic defense.

Skills.Name: Close-Range Volley
Skills.Description: Range -1. A risky rapid volley fired at closer range.

Skills.Name: Bash
Skills.Description: Mace combat art. Restore HP equal to half the damage dealt.

Skills.Name: Devotion
Skills.Description: Heal an adjacent ally for Magic + 10 HP.

Skills.Name: Shining Pillar
Skills.Description: Ultimate: Within a 2-tile radius, deal Magic + 10 damage power to enemies and heal allies for the same value. Range 0-8.

Skills.Name: Punish
Skills.Description: On hit, reduce the target's movement to 0 for one turn.

Skills.Name: Ice Spikes
Skills.Description: Deal magic damage to all enemies in a 2-tile radius and inflict Movement -3 for one turn.

Skills.Name: Return to Hell
Skills.Description: Deal magic damage to enemies in a 1-tile radius. Damage is doubled against enemies at or below half HP.

Skills.Name: Disintegrate
Skills.Description: Ultimate: Blast enemies in an infinitely long, 3-tile-wide line.

Skills.Name: Fireball
Skills.Description: Deal magic damage in a 1-tile radius and Burn every enemy caught in the blast.

Skills.Name: Clang!
Skills.Description: Strike with Fire Bat. On hit, cancel the counterattack and push the target back up to 2 tiles.

Skills.Name: Insurmountable
Skills.Description: Ultimate: If at Death's Door, heal to 1 HP. Cannot fall below 1 HP until the start of the next turn.

Skills.Name: Dark Heal
Skills.Description: Heal an adjacent ally for Magic + 8 HP, doubled if the target is at Death's Door.

Skills.Name: Anathema
Skills.Description: Deal magic damage and apply two stacks of Curse to an enemy.

Skills.Name: Dark Sanctuary
Skills.Description: Ultimate: Grant self and allies within 2 tiles Evade +50 and halve area-spell damage for one turn.

Skills.Name: Fireball
Skills.Description: A basic fire spell.

Skills.Name: Thunder
Skills.Description: A long-range lightning spell with high crit potential.

Skills.Name: Heal
Skills.Description: Restore (Mag + 10) HP to an adjacent ally.

Skills.Name: Mend
Skills.Description: Restore (Mag + 25) HP to an adjacent ally.

Skills.Name: Physic
Skills.Description: Restore (Mag + 10) HP to an ally from 1 to 10 range.

Skills.Name: Affection
Skills.Description: Restore (Mag + 25) HP to an ally at any range.

Skills.Name: Fortify
Skills.Description: Heal all allies in range for Mag + 10.

Skills.Name: Sacrifice
Skills.Description: Heal all allies in range for Mag + 25, but reduce the caster to 1 HP.

Skills.Name: Meteor
Skills.Description: Call down a meteor that deals magic damage to all enemies in range.

Skills.Name: Disintegrate
Skills.Description: Fire a destructive line that deals magic damage to all units in its path.

Skills.Name: Immolate
Skills.Description: Lose half of max HP, then deal additional magic damage equal to twice the HP lost to all enemies around you.

Skills.Name: Regen
Skills.Description: Restore 10 HP to yourself.

Skills.Name: Break
Skills.Description: An Overcharge combat art that deals bonus damage equal to the user's current HP.

Skills.Name: Shove
Skills.Description: Push an adjacent friendly unit one tile away.

Passives.Name: Fortress
Passives.Description: While Overcharged, reduce all combat damage taken by 5 and regenerate 20% of Max HP at turn start.

Passives.Name: Untouchable
Passives.Description: Avoid +25.

Passives.Name: Vantage
Passives.Description: When able to counterattack, counter before the enemy attacks. Replaces the normal counterattack.

Passives.Name: Wrath
Passives.Description: While Overcharged, gain Crit +2% for every missing point of HP.

Passives.Name: Accelerated Movement
Passives.Description: Move up to 2 additional tiles directly after taking an action.

Passives.Name: Crisis Might
Passives.Description: Gain Crit +1% for every missing point of HP.

Passives.Name: Indomitable
Passives.Description: When HP is above 1, upon taking an attack that would bring her to death’s door, endure it at 1HP. Activates once per turn.

Passives.Name: Joy of Burning
Passives.Description: Gain Str/Mag +1 for each burning enemy on the map.

Passives.Name: Cursed Existence
Passives.Description: Successful basic attacks apply one stack of Curse.

Passives.Name: Soul Stealer
Passives.Description: Hit +25.

Passives.Name: Sadist
Passives.Description: Gain Might +1 for every enemy on the map below full HP.

Passives.Name: Hegemony
Passives.Description: When initiating combat, the target cannot counterattack.

Passives.Name: Penetrate
Passives.Description: While Overcharged, ignore half of the enemy's Magic defense when dealing magic damage.

Passives.Name: Compassion
Passives.Description: When healing an ally, restore HP to self equal to half the amount actually healed.

Passives.Name: Apotheosis
Passives.Description: While Overcharged, increase the maximum range of Spell and Area Spell skills by 2.

Passives.Name: Flight
Passives.Description: Ignore terrain movement costs and traverse untraversable terrain.

Passives.Name: Deep Breath
Passives.Description: Restore 3 HP at the start of turn.

Passives.Name: Arcana Knowledge
Passives.Description: Magic +5.

Passives.Name: Aptitude
Passives.Description: Gain double EXP.

Passives.Name: Massive EXP Gain
Passives.Description: If this unit can gain EXP, set the amount to 100.

Passives.Name: Null Experience
Passives.Description: Attackers gain no EXP from this unit.

Buffs.Name: Toxic
Buffs.Description: Takes 5 direct damage per stack before each own turn. Reapplication refreshes all stacks to 3 ticks.

Buffs.Name: Burn
Buffs.Description: Takes Pain damage equal to floor((caster STR + MAG) / 2) before each own turn for up to 2 ticks. Cannot stack.

Buffs.Name: Insurmountable
Buffs.Description: Cannot fall below 1 HP from attacks or Pain damage until the next turn starts.

Buffs.Name: Punished
Buffs.Description: Movement is reduced to 0 for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Frozen
Buffs.Description: Movement -3 for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Slow
Buffs.Description: Movement and Speed -4 for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Storm Surge
Buffs.Description: Might +10 for the next combat, then removed.

Buffs.Name: Dark Sanctuary
Buffs.Description: Evade +50 and half damage from area spells for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Curse
Buffs.Description: Defense and Magic -2 per stack for 2 turns; up to 3 stacks.

Buffs.Name: Stun
Buffs.Description: Cannot act or counterattack. Skips the next full turn.

Buffs.Name: Weakening
Buffs.Description: Str/Mag/Def/Spd/Lck -1 per stack until cleansed or battle ends.

Buffs.Name: Death's Door
Buffs.Description: Survives at 0 HP or below. Taking damage again is fatal. Movement is lowered to 1.

Buffs.Name: Throne
Buffs.Description: Defense +5 and Evade +20 while standing on a Throne tile. Removed automatically on exit.

Buffs.Name: Forest
Buffs.Description: Evade +20 while standing on a Forest tile. Removed automatically on exit.

Buffs.Name: Magic Tile
Buffs.Description: Magic +5 while standing on a Magic Tile. Removed automatically on exit.

Buffs.Name: Burning Terrain
Buffs.Description: Standing on Burning Terrain. Removed automatically on exit; the separately applied Burn debuff keeps its own duration.

Buffs.Name: Black Fog
Buffs.Description: Takes 25% Max HP per fog depth before each player turn. Removed automatically after leaving the fog.

Buffs.Name: Attack Up
Buffs.Description: Increases attack power for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Guard Up
Buffs.Description: Increases defense for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Haste
Buffs.Description: Increases speed for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Focus
Buffs.Description: Improves hit and crit for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Invulnerable
Buffs.Description: Incoming damage is reduced to 1 for one turn.

Buffs.Name: Luna
Buffs.Description: Ignores Def/Mag for one round of initiated combat.

Effects.Name: Forest
Effects.Description: Evade +20 while occupied. This tile costs 2 movement.

Effects.Name: Burning Terrain
Effects.Description: Applies Burn to units standing here. Temporary applications last 2 rounds.

Effects.Name: Black Fog
Effects.Description: Applies depth-scaled Black Fog exposure to player units.
